short_description.id: Agropelter adalah "fearsome critter" yang tinggal di pohon berongga dan melempari orang dengan dahan [argopelter-c01, argopelter-c02].
short_description.en: The Agropelter is a fearsome critter that lives in hollow trees and hurls branches at people [argopelter-c01, argopelter-c02].

long_description.id: Agropelter adalah "fearsome critter" yang konon menghuni pohon berongga di hutan konifer dari Maine hingga Oregon [argopelter-c01]. Dari sana ia melempari orang yang lengah dengan serpihan kayu dan dahan [argopelter-c02], dan ia dituduh atas kematian penebang kayu yang tertimpa dahan [argopelter-c03].
long_description.en: The Agropelter is a fearsome critter said to live in hollow conifers from Maine to Oregon [argopelter-c01]. From there it hurls splinters and branches at the unwary [argopelter-c02], and was blamed when loggers died from falling branches [argopelter-c03].

long_description.id: Dalam sebuah buku tentang makhluk cerita para penebang kayu, agropelter digambarkan menjalani hidup penuh dendam dan membenci penebang kayu dari Maine sampai Oregon [argopelter-c04]. Orang yang melewati pohon berongga tempat ia tinggal biasanya ditemukan remuk atau tertindih dahan mati dan dilaporkan tewas tertimpa dahan [argopelter-c05]. Menurut seorang saksi bernama Ole, ia bertubuh ramping, berwajah jahat seperti kera, dengan lengan seperti cambuk yang melempar dahan mati bagai peluru meriam [argopelter-c06].
long_description.en: In a book on creatures of lumberjack lore, the agropelter is described as leading a vengeful existence, resenting loggers from Maine to Oregon [argopelter-c04]. Anyone passing the hollow tree where it dwells typically turns up crushed beneath a dead limb, the death being put down to a falling branch [argopelter-c05]. According to a witness named Ole, it has a slender body and the villainous face of an ape, with whip-like arms that hurl dead branches like shells from a gun [argopelter-c06].

long_description.id: Ia diduga makan burung hantu dan pelatuk, yang kelangkaannya mencegahnya menjadi banyak [argopelter-c07]. Anak-anaknya lahir pada 29 Februari dan selalu berjumlah ganjil [argopelter-c08]. Sebagian menggambarkannya begitu cepat sehingga tidak pernah terlihat [argopelter-c10], dan dalam satu kisah seekor agropelter menculik seorang surveyor perintis dan memberinya ikan mentah sampai ia kabur [argopelter-c09].
long_description.en: It is supposed to feed on hoot owls and woodpeckers, whose scarcity keeps it from becoming numerous [argopelter-c07]. Its young are born on 29 February, always in odd numbers [argopelter-c08]. Some describe it as so quick it has never been seen [argopelter-c10], and one account has an agropelter abducting a pioneer surveyor and feeding him raw fish until he got away [argopelter-c09].

cultural_context.id: Agropelter dijadikan penjelasan atas kematian penebang kayu yang tertimpa dahan [argopelter-c03].
cultural_context.en: The agropelter explained loggers killed by falling branches [argopelter-c03].

short_description.id: Arquetu adalah lelaki tua mitologi Cantabria bertanda salib hijau di dahi yang meminjamkan uang kepada pemboros dan mengutuk mereka dengan kemiskinan abadi bila mengulanginya.
short_description.en: The Arquetu is an old man of Cantabrian mythology with a green cross on his forehead who lends money to spendthrifts and curses repeat offenders with eternal poverty.

long_description.id: Arquetu adalah makhluk mitologi Cantabria yang muncul sebagai lelaki tua dengan gambar salib hijau di dahinya, ditambah 7 kunci menurut satu artikel atau tujuh titik menurut artikel bahasa Prancis. Ia meminjamkan uang kepada orang yang menghabiskan hartanya, tetapi menghukum yang mengulanginya dengan kutukan kemiskinan abadi.
long_description.en: The Arquetu is a being of Cantabrian mythology who appears as an old man with a green cross drawn on his forehead, plus 7 keys in one article or seven dots in the French one. He lends money to people who have squandered their wealth but punishes repeat offenders with a curse of eternal poverty.

long_description.id: Satu sumber menggambarkan Arquetu sebagai orang tua berambut merah panjang berjubah putih dengan bercak ungu, dengan salib hijau yang dikelilingi kunci dan gembok di dahinya. Ia membawa peti emas berhias perak dan perunggu mengilap serta kantong di bahunya. Konon ia menjelajahi gunung dan lembah Cantabria, menasihati agar orang tidak memboroskan harta; jika orang yang ditolongnya memboroskan koinnya lagi, ia menghukumnya mengemis di jalanan.
long_description.en: One source describes the Arquetu as an old man with long red hair in a white habit with purple spots, with a green cross surrounded by keys and padlocks on his forehead. He carries a golden chest adorned with silver and polished bronze and a bag at his shoulder. He is said to roam the mountains and valleys of Cantabria advising people not to squander their wealth; if those he helps waste his coins again, he condemns them to beg along the roads.

selection_criteria: computeFillStatus must be lengkap-informasi: complete, valid research without an approved image.
No active editorial artwork and no permanent artwork exclusion.
The accepted research entry is embedded unchanged; the image may only depict what its claims document.
Creatures an earlier batch left out keep that reason as catatan_sebelumnya; the generator may decline them with status tidak-digambar.

user_policy.name: sangar
user_policy.intent: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
user_policy.subject: The being dominates the frame and is clearly the subject. Head, eyes and distinguishing traits are readable even at thumbnail size. Never a landscape without the being, never a human who could be a passer-by, never a farm animal at pasture.
user_policy.moment: Depict a moment, not a pose: hunting, emerging, striking, commanding, towering, descending, tearing through weather or ground. Gaze and posture confront or loom over the viewer. Standing still and facing the camera with a neutral expression is not acceptable.
user_policy.effects: Visible power is wanted and may be strong, but every effect must come from a power, domain, attribute, habitat or deed documented in the research claims of that being, and it must act physically on the world: ground cracking, water rearing, trees bending, lightning striking, flame consuming, fog pouring, bodies of victims turned to stone. No generic glowing envelope, neon outline, energy ribbons, floating runes or luminous coloured mist. If the research documents no power, build menace from anatomy, scale, moment, light and setting instead, and record that in artistic_choices.
user_policy.fidelity: Anatomy, attributes, number of heads, eyes, limbs and iconography follow the research claims exactly. Effects and atmosphere add power; they never replace or invent anatomy. Fully opaque clothing where a humanlike form is clothed; no nudity, no explicit gore.
user_policy.composition: Low camera angle; monumental or predatory scale with small environmental references when size is documented, otherwise dominance through tight framing and foreshortening. Strong silhouette, high contrast, cinematic low-key lighting from one dominant source (moon, fire, lightning, dying sun), rim light, dust, smoke, rain or spray. Tactile surfaces: wet scales, matted fur, cracked skin, rust, weathered cloth, stone.
user_policy.setting: The place its stories name: graveyard, swamp, sea cliff, battlefield, celestial palace, desert storm. Weather and time of day heighten threat or majesty. Palette is dark and warm with one strong accent, consistent with the collection; no pastel, no flat even daylight.
user_policy.respect: Living religions (Hindu, Buddhist, Shinto, Abrahamic and folk deities still worshipped) are majestic and overwhelming rather than monstrous: cosmic scale, divine radiance from documented attributes, the elements they rule in motion. Malevolent beings are menacing. Literary beings follow their source text, never a film, game, anime or comic design.
user_policy.aniconic: If the research documents no bodily form at all, either depict the documented manifestation as an active, overwhelming force (the sky itself splitting, a storm swallowing the steppe) with the choice recorded in artistic_choices, or decline the entry with status tidak-digambar. A calm scene without agency fails.
user_policy.self_check: Before accepting an image the generator answers all of these with yes: the being dominates the frame; it still looks dangerous or majestic at 200 px; there is a moment, not a static pose; each visible effect points to a claim id; head, eye and limb counts match the claims; no text, watermark, border or borrowed design; it would not be rejected as ordinary person, ordinary animal, landscape only, or cute and calm. One no means regenerate, keep the rejected attempt as history, up to three attempts.
user_policy.style: Square premium painterly cinematic illustration in the house style of the existing artwork, more dramatic and higher contrast. No text, labels, logo, border or watermark.
user_policy.sources: Never copy designs from films, games, anime or comics (modern_depictions). Every design is original and sourced from the accepted research.
